_: The terrace has no hand for a star, and that is the measurement. Its 24 star strokes fall into 9 clusters of which the biggest is 7 marks: he paints a star here as one pale dab, not as the core and rings the Starry Night gives. So our stars keep the Starry Night's hand (hand/starry-star.json) and this file is kept as the record of what was asked and what came back. BUILD.md D4.
